limitations: The 378 genes annotated 'Not detected' in the RNA tissue specificity category still carry a consensus nTPM ≥ 1 in salivary gland; this reflects the atlas's own specificity classification, which may use additional criteria beyond the raw nTPM threshold.
Olink (immunoassay) blood concentrations are blank for all 12 ranked genes; only mass-spectrometry concentrations are available for this subset.
The MS blood concentration column records a single value per gene as stored in the atlas; it is not a mean across samples.
The ranked list was drawn from 776 eligible genes (secreted AND with at least one blood measurement); the full 1,230 secreted cohort genes were not all measured in blood.

limitations: 378 cohort genes carry the 'Not detected' RNA tissue specificity category despite meeting the nTPM ≥ 1 inclusion threshold; this reflects the atlas's specificity classification criteria (which may require detection in a minimum number of samples or a higher expression threshold) differing from the simple nTPM ≥ 1 filter used to define the cohort.

Olink blood concentrations (mean_conc [pg/L]) are blank for all 12 ranked genes, meaning none of them are measured by the Olink immunoassay panel; their blood concentrations come solely from mass spectrometry.
The MS blood concentration column records a single value per gene as stored in the atlas; if multiple measurements exist they are not separately reported here.

The 'secreted to blood' filter used for ranking requires both a 'Predicted secreted proteins' or 'Plasma proteins' protein-class annotation and at least one blood measurement (Olink or MS); genes that are secreted but lack a blood measurement are excluded from the ranking pool.
